# Scientific evidence and release status

**Source-bound snapshot: 21 November 2026.** The [published v0.1.2 GitHub release](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/releases/tag/v0.1.2) qualifies research software and a reproducible synthetic example. This page is not a continuously updated benchmark database. A successful software test is not independent measurement of fish biology.

## Scientific Core 2.0: five engineering milestones completed

| Workstream | Bounded outcome | Evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 01 — Architecture | Documented unit-aware 2D/3D scientific interfaces | [PRs #100–102](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/pull/102) |
| 02 — QC 2.0 | Preserved original-row lineage, gap/missingness/exclusion reporting | [PR #103](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/pull/103) |
| 03 — Numerical validation | Independent known-answer and metamorphic tests | [PR #104](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/pull/104) |
| 04 — Visualization 2.0 | QC-linked journal figure specifications and four export formats | [PR #105](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/pull/105) |
| 05 — Reproducible research | Frozen source-to-report, independent Python oracle, measured coverage and three-OS benchmarks | [PR #106](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/pull/106) |

The release-candidate coverage run measured **89.33% executed R source coverage**, above the 80% gate. **24 runtime and allocation-memory workloads were benchmarked per OS** on Linux, Windows and macOS. The independently recomputed synthetic example has **17 source observations, 10 eligible movements and 10 cm of supported distance**. The [full reproducibility walkthrough](reproducible-research-release.html) states the commands, assumptions, provenance and measured performance; software coverage is not a numerical-certification percentage.

## Biological and physical validation remains distinct

The [nine-domain frozen scientific registry](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.2/inst/evidence/scientific-validation-gates.json), with underlying evidence recorded **12 November 2026**, has `scientific_certified = false` in all nine domains. Those flags were not silently promoted by the Scientific Core 2.0 engineering release.

| Independent scientific claim | Remaining external evidence |
|:--|:--|
| Fish detection | Held-out, prediction-blind fish box labels across species, tanks and visibility conditions |
| Fish identity | Adjudicated held-out identities and official association evaluation |
| Multi-camera exposure timing | Independently measured shutter/exposure clock evidence |
| Physical underwater XYZ | Surveyed independent 3D underwater targets and calibration holdouts |
| Joint uncertainty | Observed detector/identity/calibration errors and empirical coverage |
| Behaviour and tank inference | Ethological truth, independent tank replication and design validity |
| Research explorer | Independent real multiview and usability review |
| Physical ACI | Ethics-approved physical safety interlocks and independent fish outcomes |
| Independent scientific release | Third-party replication and externally reviewed research-system claims |

**Publication practice:** identify the exact software tag; record original input hashes, camera/track scopes, units, QC exclusions, figure-to-input lineage, independent tanks and separately validated physical/biological references. See the [capability matrix](capabilities-and-validation.html) and [scientific status](scientific-status.html).

**Citation discipline:** v0.1.2 uses its [versioned GitHub source and CITATION.cff](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.2/CITATION.cff). The [Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24262905](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24262905) and [BibTeX](../AquaTrajectories-v0.1.1.bib) refer to historical **v0.1.1**, not v0.1.2.
